Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Agnivesh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manoj Bajaj,J.
Smt. Anita @ Reeta Rajput-Complainant has approached this Court through this application under Section 482 Code of Criminal Procedure for issuance of directions to the police to further investigate/ re-investigate the Case Crime No. 93 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376-D, 392, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Jahanganj, District Farrukhabad.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that initially the statement of the victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C. was recorded on 10.4.2023 and thereafter, her statement was recorded before the Magistrate under Section 164 Cr.P.C. on 11.4.2023.

He submits that after recording of the statements, there was no occasion for the investigating officer to again record the statement of victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C. on 12.4.2023 and this procedure of investigation adopted by investigating officer rendered the investigation improper.

In this regard, he has drawn the attention of the Court to the communication dated 29.10.2021 by D.G.P., Uttar Pradesh, whereby following Smt. Anita @ Reeta Rajput vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95627891/
1 directions of this Court given on 1.10.2021, it was conveyed to the investigating officers that in the crime against women where the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. is recorded by the Magistrate,
and if, the same is found to be different to the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. recorded earlier,
no further statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. may be recorded as it questions the sanctity of the statement of victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C.

entities.text: Smt. Anita @ Reeta Rajput vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has further argued that during the investigation, investigating officer recorded the statements of the accused and proceeded to give weightage to their stand and declared them innocent.

He submits that against the final report submitted by the police, the applicant preferred a protest petition and requested for conducting further investigation in the case,
but through the order dated 2.9.2023, the Special Judge, P.O.C.S.O. Act, Farrukhabad has proceeded to adopt the procedure contained under Chapter XV Cr.P.C. by treating it as a complaint case.
He submits that in this case, the necessary directions be issued to the police for further investigation.

After hearing the counsel and considering his submissions, this Court finds that even if, the instructions given by the D.G.P. Uttar Pradesh on 29.10.2021 were not followed by the investigating officer, it cannot be said that the entire investigation is defective.

A perusal of the order dated 2.9.2023 would show that Special Judge, P.O.C.S.O. Act, Farrukhabad has examined the final report carefully and passed a detailed order while proceeding with the grievance of the applicant, in the manner and procedure meant for a complaint case.

During the course of hearing, learned counsel is unable to point out any statement of the accused recorded by the investigating officer, which is part of the final report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C. and further no explanation has been given for not challenging the order dated 2.9.2023.

The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Devendra Nath Singh vs The State Of Bihar, 2022 SCC Online SC 1389, while dealing with the issue of investigation/further investigation/ re-investigation laid down the principles for exercise of powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C. and clearly held that such power is to be exercised by the High Court sparingly, with circumspection and in exceptional cases.

entities.text: Devendra Nath Singh vs The State Of Bihar, 2022 SCC Online SC 1389
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Court does not find any exceptional ground for ordering fresh investigation/ further investigation, therefore, without meaning any expression of opinion on the merits of the case, the application is hereby dismissed.
